svg.title: Relational model, sheet 1
svg.text: Sheet 1 of 2 - Patent catalog and knowledge relationships
Mapping from Chen sheet 1 | Full table attributes, primary/foreign keys, and junction tables
Current incoming citation count is nonnegative.
HAS: one patent, zero or more snapshots.
RELATED TO: both FK fields reference patents.
A publication cannot be related to itself.
Optional preferred display domain (separate from all-domain memberships)
ASSIGNED TO, INVENTS, CLASSIFIED AS and CITES become separate junction tables.
patent_domains retains every domain membership; patents.domain_id selects a preferred domain.
The family relation has a three-part PK: patent_id, related_patent_id and relation_type.
Citation snapshots keep observation history; patent publication IDs remain separate records.
PK = primary key (underlined) FK = foreign key UQ = unique constraint ? = NULL permitted
All PK-marked fields in a table form ONE key. Arrows point from FK fields to referenced PKs; joined branches share that PK target.
Defaults and secondary indexes omitted. [ref] repeats an existing table.
